ananya.name: Dr. Ananya
ananya.description: Indian woman in her late 30s, clinic owner and doctor. Calm, confident and caring. Teal kurta beneath an open white coat (source). Shoulder-length black hair tied in a low bun with a few loose strands, slim build, small gold stud earrings, a stethoscope worn around her neck (never in use) in every scene where she wears the white coat (manga supplement, from the accepted reference sheet).

Soft, straight medium-thick eyebrows set fairly level
Oval face with a defined, slightly pointed chin and a small bindi-free forehead; small nose with a rounded tip

script.style: Full-colour, approachable Indian slice-of-life manga. Clean confident line art with varied line weight, soft flat cel shading, warm natural daylight, restrained blue and teal accents, simple readable backgrounds. Expressive but natural faces, precise hands. No photorealism, no glossy gradients, no surface microtexture. Absolutely no text, letters, logos, numbers, speech bubbles or captions inside the artwork; device screens show only abstract blank blocks and simple icons.
script.continuity: Keep Dr. Ananya, Meera, Ravi, the Nurse, Mr. Raman, Priya, the Pharmacist and the Lab Technician identical to their canonical reference sheets in face traits, hair, build, skin tone and clothing for the whole comic. Device screens never show readable text or real personal data. Page 10 panels 2-3 (10-2, 10-3) are a future vision: soft pale-blue vignette border and lighter, airy palette so they never read as current features.

pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-01.png with Read and looked at the lettered art. The page has three panels. Panel A is the full-width top tier. Its caption at top left reads 'A busy day at Dr. Ananya's clinic.' A doctor in a white coat and teal dress stands in the clinic doorway and welcomes an elderly woman in a lilac sari. Two patients wait on metal chairs at right. There is no dialogue. Panel B is the tall bottom-left panel. A receptionist in a blue kurta with a long braid is on the desk phone and writing in a ledger, beside a stack of books, with patients' heads in the foreground. 'Appointments, patient details, follow-ups...' has a tail down to her head. 'I wish everything were easier to manage!' is to its right, slightly lower, also with a tail to her. She has a smiling open mouth, a sweat drop and stress marks. Panel C is the bottom-right panel. The doctor stands with her hand on her chin, and the receptionist is still on the phone in the background. 'Our time belongs with patients. Let's make the rest simpler.' has a tail to the doctor's head. Reading order: caption, receptionist 'Appointments...', receptionist 'I wish...', doctor 'Our time belongs...'.
pages.observation: Reading order and tails are clear. The doctor's line reads as a reply to the receptionist's complaint, and in Panel C she looks thoughtful. In Panel B the receptionist is smiling broadly while she complains. Only the sweat drop signals stress, so her expression slightly undercuts 'I wish everything were easier to manage!' No balloon or caption covers a face or hand. Panel A sets the clinic and its busyness well. All text is readable.
